attempts.summary: Created user datauser on node1 and provisioned /srv/data as its own 100MB ext4 loopback filesystem (backed by /srv/datauser.img, mounted via /etc/fstab), owned exclusively by datauser. The 100MB cap is enforced by the filesystem itself: writes beyond ~86MB usable space fail with ENOSPC. Verified enforcement both before and after a full node restart (boot_id changed, confirming a real reboot), and confirmed the mount, ownership, and quota enforcement all survive persistently.
